description: An ordered, append-only log inside a topic, which is the unit of ordering and parallelism.
The value that selects the partition, so records with the same key stay in order.
A set of instances that share a topic, with each partition assigned to one instance of the group.
The Spring component that sends records and returns a CompletableFuture with the result.
The annotation that turns a method into a consumer of a topic within a consumer group.
A wrapper that turns a deserialization failure into a handled error instead of an endless retry.
